full_text_en:
Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, Lu Haicheng, and Meng Qingxuan — Robbery Case

Defendant: Zhang Jian, male, born on February 13, 1965, Han nationality, farmer, from Qinglong Manchu Autonomous County, Hebei Province. Arrested on April 12, 1996.

Defendant: Liu Feng, male, born on March 1, 1978, Korean ethnicity, farmer, from Jiaohe City, Jilin Province. On January 5, 1995, he was sentenced to one year fixed-term imprisonment for theft and was released upon completion of his sentence on September 1 of the same year. Arrested on April 12, 1996.

Defendant: Lu Haicheng, male, born on August 25, 1967, Manchu ethnicity, farmer, from Qinglong Manchu Autonomous County, Hebei Province. Arrested on June 11, 1996.

Defendant: Meng Qingxuan, male, born on July 12, 1967, Manchu ethnicity, farmer, from Qinglong Manchu Autonomous County, Hebei Province. On August 17, 1987, he was sentenced to eight years fixed-term imprisonment for theft and was released upon completion of his sentence in February 1995. Arrested on June 21, 1996.

The case of robbery by defendants Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, Lu Haicheng, and Meng Qingxuan was prosecuted by the People's Procuratorate of Tangshan City, Hebei Province, before the Tangshan Intermediate People's Court.

The Tangshan Intermediate People's Court, after public trial, found the following facts:

Defendants Zhang Jian and Lu Haicheng, together with Liu Yuxiang, Jiao Xiaoqiang, Yang Guoxing (all separately prosecuted), and Yu Lianping (at large), on September 17, 1995, at Lianpeng Mountain on Beidaihe Beach, robbed Zhang Baoguo and Zhao Xinhua of one gold necklace, one gold ring, one camera, and over RMB 320. On the afternoon of January 13, 1996, the two defendants, together with Zhao Yongguang (separately prosecuted), Yang Guoxing, and others, robbed passenger Cui Yufu of RMB 256 on a long-distance bus from Chengde to Qinhuangdao. On February 4 of the same year, the two defendants, together with Zhao Yongguang, robbed Zhang Shengjun and Wang Yuwen of RMB 100 and one Shuangshi watch at Dachengshan Park in Tangshan.

Defendants Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, and Lu Haicheng, at noon on February 24, 1996, went to Dachengshan Park in Tangshan and robbed Meng Tianzeng and Yang Ping of RMB 1,650, one pager, two gold rings, one watch, one tape recorder, and one leather jacket. On the afternoon of March 15 of the same year, Zhang Jian and Lu Haicheng, together with Zhao Yongguang, robbed Li Qiang and Xie Lijun of RMB 690 at Dachengshan Park. At noon on March 17, Zhang Jian and Liu Feng, together with Pan Zhiqiang (separately prosecuted), robbed Bai Wen and Chen Yan of one gold ring, one pair of gold earrings, and RMB 320 at Dachengshan Park.

Defendants Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, Lu Haicheng, and Meng Qingxuan, together with Pan Zhiqiang and Lü Chun (separately prosecuted), on the evening of March 17, 1996, at Changgezhuang Bridge in Tangshan, robbed Cui Zhigang and Sun Qi of one pager and over RMB 900. On one evening in March of the same year, the four defendants robbed a taxi driver of RMB 200 at a parking lot near Tangshan West Railway Station.

Defendants Zhang Jian and Liu Feng, together with Pan Zhiqiang, at noon on March 19, 1996, at Dachengshan Park in Tangshan, pushed People's Police Officer Wang Yiming to the ground; Liu Feng struck Wang's head violently with a stone; they then robbed Wang of one Type 54 pistol, seven rounds of ammunition, one pager, and over RMB 200, and robbed Guan Xiurong of RMB 140. Wang Yiming's injuries were identified as serious by forensic examination.

In summary, defendant Zhang Jian participated in nine robberies, robbing over RMB 5,000, one Type 54 pistol, seven rounds of ammunition, three pagers, one gold necklace, four gold rings, one pair of gold earrings, one tape recorder, one camera, and two watches.

Defendant Lu Haicheng participated in seven robberies, robbing over RMB 4,000, two pagers, one gold necklace, three gold rings, one tape recorder, one camera, and two watches.

Defendant Liu Feng participated in five robberies, robbing one Type 54 pistol, seven rounds of ammunition, over RMB 3,100, three pagers, three gold rings, one tape recorder, one pair of gold earrings, and one watch.

Defendant Meng Qingxuan participated in two robberies, robbing over RMB 1,100 and one pager.

The above facts are confirmed by the victims' reports and records of their statements, the recovered stolen money and goods, the records of crime scene investigation, forensic science identification reports, forensic medical examination conclusions, and the certification from Baishishan Police Station of Jiaohe City Public Security Bureau, Jilin Province, regarding Liu Feng's birth on March 1, 1978. The time, place, means, circumstances, and property robbed as confessed by each defendant are consistent with the victims' accounts. The facts are clear and the evidence is reliable.

The Tangshan Intermediate People's Court held that the defendants Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, Lu Haicheng, and Meng Qingxuan, disregarding the laws of the state, repeatedly formed gangs to rob others of property in public places, and even robbed a police officer of firearms and ammunition. Their conduct violated Article 150 of the Criminal Law of the PRC and constituted the crime of robbery, with aggravated circumstances, and thus they should be severely punished. The four defendants committed joint crimes. Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, and Lu Haicheng played major roles in the joint crimes and were principal offenders, and should be given heavier punishment in accordance with Article 23 of the Criminal Law; Meng Qingxuan played a secondary role in the joint crimes and was an accessory, and should be given a lighter punishment compared to the principal offenders in accordance with Article 24 of the Criminal Law. Liu Feng was under 18 years old at the time of the robbery on February 24, 1996, and should be given a lighter punishment in accordance with Article 14(3) of the Criminal Law. Liu Feng and Meng Qingxuan committed new crimes within three years after the completion of their previous sentences; they were recidivists and should be given heavier punishment in accordance with Article 61 of the Criminal Law. Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, Lu Haicheng, and Meng Qingxuan were all criminals who seriously undermined social order; for Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, and Lu Haicheng, deprivation of political rights for life should be imposed in accordance with Article 53(1) of the Criminal Law; for Meng Qingxuan, additional deprivation of political rights should be imposed in accordance with Article 52 of the Criminal Law. Accordingly, on April 17, 1997, the court rendered the following judgment: Defendants Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, and Lu Haicheng were each sentenced to death for robbery and deprived of political rights for life; defendant Meng Qingxuan was sentenced to ten years fixed-term imprisonment for robbery and deprived of political rights for two years.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, Zhang Jian appealed to the Hebei High People's Court on the grounds that he did not rob or beat Wang Yiming, did not participate in robbing Cui Yufu, and had exposed the crimes of others; Liu Feng appealed on the grounds that he was born on April 7, 1978, was under 18 at the time of the crime, and did not play a major role in robbing Wang Yiming; Lu Haicheng appealed on the grounds that he did not participate in robbing Zhang Baoguo and that the sentence was excessive.

The Hebei High People's Court held that the facts found by the original judgment that the appellants Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, Lu Haicheng, and the defendant Meng Qingxuan committed robbery were clear, the evidence was reliable and sufficient. Zhang Jian had previously confessed to robbing Wang Yiming's firearm and robbing Cui Yufu on a bus, and co-defendants had also provided confirming testimony; his appeal that he did not participate in these two robberies was not factual. His appeal that he had exposed the crimes of others was found to be untrue upon investigation. Liu Feng robbed Wang Yiming and struck him with a brick causing serious injury; his appeal that he did not play a major role was unfounded. Liu Feng had repeatedly confessed that he was born on March 1, 1978, which was consistent with the certification from his local police station; his present appeal that he was born on April 7, 1978, was not factual. Lu Haicheng's appeal that he did not participate in robbing Zhang Baoguo was found to be true upon investigation, and should be corrected. Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, and Lu Haicheng committed multiple robberies, caused one person serious injury, had aggravated circumstances, and caused great social harm; Liu Feng was a recidivist; all should be sentenced to death. The first-instance judgment was correct in conviction, appropriate in sentencing, and the trial procedure was lawful. Accordingly, in accordance with Article 189(1) and Article 197 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, on July 30, 1997, the court rendered the following ruling: The appeals of Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, and Lu Haicheng were dismissed; the original judgment was affirmed in its entirety.

Pursuant to the provisions of the Supreme People's Court authorizing high people's courts to approve certain death penalty cases, the Hebei High People's Court, by the same ruling, approved the criminal judgment of the Tangshan Intermediate People's Court sentencing defendants Zhang Jian, Liu Feng, and Lu Haicheng to death and depriving them of political rights for life for robbery.
